title: How to Get to the WKU Campus
writingModel: How to Get to WKU from the City Centre — by Rustam Seilov
Getting to WKU from the city centre is straightforward once you know the route. Here are directions from the Central Mosque — one of the most recognisable landmarks in Uralsk.

Start at the Central Mosque. With the mosque on your right, walk along the main road heading north. You'll pass a row of shops on your left and a small park on your right. After about five minutes, you'll see a large intersection ahead.

At the intersection, cross the road using the pedestrian crossing. Once you're across, continue straight on. Don't turn — go past the hospital on your right and the post office on your left. You're now on Dostyq Avenue.

Walk along Dostyq Avenue for about seven minutes. You'll go past the central fountain and a large supermarket. Just past the supermarket, there's a set of traffic lights. Cross the road there and turn right.

After turning right, walk along the side street for about two minutes. You'll go through a small archway — it looks narrow but it's perfectly safe. Once you're through the archway, you'll see the WKU main gate directly ahead.

The whole journey takes about twenty minutes on foot from the Central Mosque. Alternatively, take Bus 5 from outside the mosque — it stops directly in front of the main gate and takes about eight minutes. You can't miss the bus stop — it's right next to the pharmacy across from the mosque.
